name: Who owns a hive?
source:
You volunteered. You read the fine print. Now your body's been turned into something useful. Efficient. Productive.

The bees don't sting. They just grow.

[From [url=https://iamtheonewhohates.itch.io/who-owns-a-hive]Itch.io[/url]]
